findings.title: Duplicate conversion precedence conflicts with universal Create revision/source preconditions
findings.evidence: Line61 compares task revision/source/selected attestation for every new Create; line63 fresh duplicate requires only authority/visibility/source integrity before AlreadyExists. findings.title: New ReconfirmPlan at already CurrentPlan has no specified outcome
findings.evidence: Reconfirm restricted to Planned/InProgress, existing identity/nonRejected/all3Reviewed, but no requirement for NeedsReconfirmation or explicit permission for repeated equal binding with a fresh UUID. TC14-T03/T11 do not specify this edge.

findings.recommendation: Choose only NeedsReconfirmation for new ReconfirmPlan (historical exact replay remains receipt-only), or explicitly approve CurrentPlan reconfirm and test the equal-binding event outcome.
